name: evaluation_id
description: Evaluation run id this flag belongs to; joins to evaluation_data_history.evaluation_id.

name: table_name
description: Table this flagged row belongs to.

name: rank
description: Rank of this flagged row within its check (1 = most extreme).

name: source_key_hash
description: salted hash of the matched source key; raw only with --row_flags_source_keys=raw

name: source_key
description: NULL unless raw keys were requested

name: distance
description: Distance between the synthetic row and its matched source row.
